Replaced the native HTML `title` attribute tooltip on the benchmark column headers in the Frontier Model Rankings table with a custom CSS-based tooltip that only appears when hovering a small inline "i" (info) icon.

**Before:** `title={c.tip}` on the `<th>` element — browser shows a native tooltip when hovering anywhere over the column header cell.

**After:** No `title` attribute. An SVG info icon sits next to the column label, and a styled tooltip floats above it only when that icon is hovered (using Tailwind's `group/info` named-group pattern).

- No new dependencies added — tooltip is pure Tailwind CSS.
- `pointer-events-none` on the tooltip box prevents it from interfering with mouse events.
- The tooltip text is reset to `font-normal normal-case tracking-normal` so it doesn't inherit the header's `uppercase`/`tracking-wider` styles.

# Dev Completion Report (Round 2)

## What Was Fixed

**Root cause**: The tooltip was invisible despite correct hover scoping because of CSS overflow clipping. The `group/info` implementation from Round 1 was logically correct — `group-hover/info:opacity-100` only fires when hovering the icon wrapper — but the tooltip was being rendered outside the visible bounds of two ancestor overflow containers:

1. `<div class="overflow-x-auto">` — wraps the table. Since `overflow-x: auto` is set, CSS spec computes `overflow-y: auto` as well, clipping any absolutely-positioned descendant that overflows the div's top edge.
2. `<div class="... overflow-hidden">` — the outer card container, which clips everything to the rounded border.

The tooltip used `bottom-full mb-2` (above the icon), which positioned it above the `<thead>` row — above both overflow boundaries — making it invisible.

**Fix**: Changed `bottom-full mb-2` → `top-full mt-1` so the tooltip renders below the icon, inside the scroll container's visible area. At `z-10` with `pointer-events-none`, it floats over the first data row without visual artifacts or interaction interference.

## Files Changed

- `src/app/components/ModelComparisonTeaser.tsx` — line 137: tooltip positioning changed from `bottom-full mb-2` to `top-full mt-1`

## Testing

- `tsc --noEmit` passes (only the pre-existing `baseUrl` deprecation, unrelated to this change).
- Verified by inspection: tooltip's `absolute top-full` positions it below the `group/info relative` span, inside the `overflow-x-auto` div, within the outer card's `overflow-hidden` boundary.

## Remaining Caveats

- Tooltips are hover-only; they don't work on touch/mobile. This is a pre-existing limitation with no native fallback — descriptions are only visible on desktop.
- The tooltip appears below (not above) the column header, which slightly overlaps the first data row while hovering. This is the necessary tradeoff to work around the overflow clipping constraints.
